purpose: Does the reader tell a product's own revenue line from a line covering more than that product, on issuers it was never built against? Labels are printed row labels harvested from the product-revenue schedule of each issuer's own 8-K earnings exhibit.
answer_key: Assigned by reading the printed label: 'shared' when the label names more than one product the issuer reports separately, 'own' otherwise. Two trade names for a single product are 'own' - the value is that product's.
